# Stacy

## Overview

- **Age:** Young  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** School teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She has lovely, fair curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses beautifully, wearing sleeves with notably large puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

She is bright, sympathetic, and ladylike, possessing a sweet voice and a happy gift for winning the affection of her pupils. She leads her students to think, explore, and discover for themselves, encouraging them to venture beyond traditional learning methods. Tactful and broadminded, she inspires and brings out the best in her pupils mentally and morally.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as Avonlea's first female schoolteacher. Upon taking over the school, she introduced novel educational activities such as Friday afternoon recitations, field days for studying nature in the woods, daily physical culture exercises, and composition writing. In November of her first year, she organized a Christmas concert with her students to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. She later formed an advanced class for students preparing for the entrance examination to Queen's Academy, offering them an extra hour of instruction after school. Though offered a teaching position in her home district, she chose to stay in Avonlea to see her Queen's class through their final preparation. She thoroughly drilled and guided her students, instructing them to rest and refrain from studying during the exam period. Following the end of the term, her pupils all successfully passed the Queen's entrance exams. In later years, she maintained her bond with her former pupils and was invited to attend social occasions at Green Gables.

## Background by volume

- Was hired as the first female teacher in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Admitted to being a dunce at geometry when she was younger  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Was offered a position in her home district grade school but chose to remain in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
